title: i made a game about saying no to flour.
author: borick
selftext:
Dock 3 is Papers, Please at a dry ingredients factory. check the bill of lading against the ERP and real Canadian food law, then stamp it. five shifts, new laws every morning.

i made it by talking with Savi on Spawn. i chose the factory setting, the real food rules and the ERP checks. Savi helped with the build.

i also had the desk fold away so you could see the hall. the warehouse blur i was trying to fix turned out to be the booth glass. apparently i needed to inspect my own window.

free, play it in your browser: https://www.spawn.co/@borick/dock-3
